proof_body:
by
  intro a b c k ha
  have ha2 : 0 < a ^ 2 := by positivity
  constructor
  · intro hf
    have hD : 0 ≤ b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * a * k + b)]
    obtain ⟨v, t, ht, hb, hc, hv⟩ : ∃ v t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ b = -2 * a * v ∧ c = a * (v ^ 2 - t ^ 2) ∧ v = -b / (2 * a) := by
      have hs2 := Real.sq_sqrt hD
      refine ⟨-b / (2 * a), |Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) / (2 * a)|, abs_nonneg _, by field_simp, ?_, rfl⟩
      rw [sq_abs, div_pow, div_pow, hs2]
      field_simp
      ring
    clear hv hD
    subst hb hc
    have e : a * (a * k ^ 2 + -2 * a * v * k + a * (v ^ 2 - t ^ 2)) = a ^ 2 * ((k - v) ^ 2 - t ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [e] at hf
    have h5 : (k - v) ^ 2 < t ^ 2 := by
      by_contra hn
      push_neg at hn
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha2.le (sub_nonneg.2 hn)]
    have h7 := abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq' h5 ht
    exact ⟨v - t, v + t, fun x => by ring, by linarith [h7.1], by linarith [h7.2]⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, q, h, hp, hq⟩
    rw [h k]
    have e : a * (a * (k - p) * (k - q)) = a ^ 2 * ((k - p) * (k - q)) := by ring
    rw [e]
    exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg ha2 (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by linarith) (by linarith))
